charge_description: Using a half-stone weight and a quarter-stone weight, which were both defective
raw_record: Summary conviction of Edward Turner of the township of Whitby for using a half-stone weight and a quarter-stone weight, which were both defective. Offence committed at Whitby on 29 August 1818. Case heard at Whitby at a Petty Sessions for the division of Whitby Strand.
